player_prompt.intro:
Yin ee Player {player_id} ee kat geimei ee Indian Poker.
- Dek kat 52; yin riŋ diɛɛt ke cieŋ ke kɔɔc.
- Ante {ante} chip(s) ke kare kɔɔc, {max_rounds} kare kɔɔc pɛɛt.
- Luui ke riɛɛl: '[check]'  |  '[bet X]'  |  '[call]'  |  '[raise X]'  |  '[fold]'  (X ee aya deŋ ke kɔɔc ke riɛɛl <= chip ca ke yin.)
- Kɔɔc ke nɔɔk aya ke kɔɔc ke riɛɛl ee kat ke kɔɔc ke showdown.

invalid_move.ambiguous: Tik ke luui muor, e.g. '[check]', '[bet 2]', '[call]', '[raise 3]', ku '[fold]'.
invalid_move.cannot_check: /Ciɛ [check] -duŋdɛ ɣöö ɛ mi̱ laar jɛ i̱ bi̱ ji̱n rɔ cu thöp.
invalid_move.amount_min: Bet / Raise mi̱ ci̱ pekdɛ bi̱ tekɛ 1 kiɛ di̱t ni̱ jɛn.
invalid_move.nothing_to_call: Thilɛ mi̱ bi̱ cɔl; deri̱ [check] la̱t ni̱ jɛ.
invalid_move.no_bet_to_raise: La̱t kɛ [bet X] mi̱ bi̱ jiek; thiɛlɛ yiöw ti̱ ba kap nhial.
invalid_move.insufficient: /Thiɛlɛ ji̱-piipni ti ro̱ŋ kɛ kui̱ la̱t ɛmɔ.

message.showdown_win: Showdown: {card_win} beats {card_lose}. Kä min la̱tkɛ ɛ nɛy tin kɔ̱ŋ, laa jɛ a latkɛ kä gua̱th in ca naath yiath piny thi̱n i̱ bi̱ kɛn rɔ̱ ku lɛ luäk kɛ ɣöö /ci̱ kɛnɛ ti̱ dee tuɔɔk.
message.showdown_tie: Showdown tie: ke {card}. Pot split – ke ke {split}.

outcome.draw: Cäätni̱ ti̱ti̱ kɛ kɔr kä mëë ci̱kɛ diaal thuɔ̱k.
